statements.statement: The service billed was cardiac event monitoring with CPT code 93271
The patient has a history of recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The denial reason code was CO-97
The denial was based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
